text:
Maya Chen: @orchard-team quick heads up — Orchard Payments wants to onboard a custom ensemble (three-model stack) for transaction tagging. They require PHI-aware redaction, HSM keywrap, and a focused safety eval on false positives. Can we scope requirements and timeline?

Orchard_SRE: Thanks Maya. We can share sample logs. Critical constraints: all PHI must be masked client-side, models must run in our VPC (private deployment), and HSM is required for key management. Target go-live end of next month but flexible with a clear eval plan.

Liam O'Neill: @Maya @Priya assigning intake to Priya. Priya — can you confirm whether this should be Dedicated vs Private? Also need to confirm how model artifacts will be delivered (we pull from S3, or customer uploads to our importer).

Priya Patel: I'll take the intake. @Orchard_SRE quick question: will you provide a sanitized dataset for evals or prefer Redwood run synthetic prompt-based tests? Also confirm expected throughput (req/s) and latency SLOs.

Orchard_SRE: We can provide redacted CSV exports (~50k rows) with labels. Anything still PHI must remain masked. We prefer Redwood to run evals inside our VPC (private deployment) for compliance. Throughput: baseline 20-30 rps, burst to 60. Latency target is p95 < 200ms.

OnboardBot: Ticket created CS-23189: orch-payments-custom-ensemble. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-23189

Maya Chen: Priya — also flag renewal risk: customer is negotiating pricing post-POC. They want measurable eval success criteria to move to committed capacity. Sales wants a timeline and an ops checklist they can review.

Priya Patel: Proposed eval plan (draft): 1) label accuracy on provided set, 2) false-positive (FP) rate for high-severity fraud flags < 0.5%, 3) latency p95 < 150ms in private deployment. I'll draft a measurement harness. Example eval config we plan to run:
```eval_config:
  test_set: orchard_sanitized.csv
  metrics: [accuracy, fp_rate, latency_p95, throughput]
  thresholds: {fp_rate: 0.005, latency_p95: 0.15}
  run_mode: "in_vpc"
```

Liam O'Neill: For HSM/integration — tagging @eng-security to confirm keywrap modes and any cert prerequisites for Thales HSM. Also we'll recommend quantization profiles (4-bit) to save cost if model size permits.

Orchard_SRE: HSM is Thales in our colo. We need guidance on client certs and mutual TLS for the private control plane. Can we schedule a 30-min ops/runbook sync Tuesday 10am PT?

Maya Chen: Scheduled — Priya can you take runbook and ops checklist? I'll loop in Sales (Eli Turner) for renewal posture and timeline.

Priya Patel: Yep — I'll create the runbook checklist and share prework. Also capturing enablement feedback: please ask their eng team to fill this pre-sync form: https://forms.redwood/engage/orchard-onboard (short, 6 q).

Liam O'Neill: Quick notes on artifacts: if they supply a custom 13B fine-tuned model, recommend 4-bit quant + Triton containerized runtime. I'll attach the internal deployment doc after this thread. Also support canary routing to baseline for first 72h.

Orchard_SRE: Canary routing yes — they'd like 5% traffic initially, ramp to 25% after 24h, full switch at 72h if metrics ok.

Maya Chen: Noted. I'll block time on calendars and file a CS success plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Adding next steps: (1) Priya to post intake checklist & runbook by EOD, (2) Orchard to share sanitized sample dataset and HSM cert contact, (3) eng-security to confirm HSM integration requirements, (4) schedule Tuesday 10am PT sync.

Orchard_SRE: Confirmed — dataset share scheduled for tomorrow SFTP link. See you on Tuesday.

Liam O'Neill: Thanks team — tagging internal doc: https://intra.redwood/ops/private-deploy-hsm-guide (will attach in ticket).
